# Foliant v0.1.0 (Alpha)

> **This is an ALPHA release.** It is feature-complete for the Phase 1 scope but
> has not been hardened on a wide range of documents or machines. Expect rough
> edges, and please report issues. Do not rely on it for critical work.

Foliant is a fast, native Windows reader for PDF and DjVu documents with search,
annotations, OCR, and full RU/EN localization.

## Highlights

- Open and read **PDF** and **DjVu** documents with smooth, virtualized rendering.
- View modes: **Single**, **Continuous**, and **Two-Page** (with an optional
  separate cover page), plus Fit Width / Fit Page / Actual Size.
- **Full-text search** across the document with on-page highlight, backed by a
  persistent SQLite FTS5 index.
- **Annotations** — highlights, sticky notes, and freehand ink — with an "All
  Annotations" sidebar and JSON export.
- **OCR** for scanned pages via in-process PaddleOCR (offline models).
- **Light / Dark / High-Contrast** themes and **Russian / English** UI with
  hot-switching.

## Added

- **Viewing & navigation**: Single / Continuous (virtualized) / Two-Page +
  separate-cover layouts; Fit Width / Page / Actual; lazy per-page rendering;
  keyboard navigation (Page Up/Down, Ctrl+Home/End), zoom shortcuts
  (Ctrl +/-/0), multi-tab navigation (Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab / Ctrl+W), and a
  status bar showing page number and zoom percentage.
- **Thumbnail strip**: lazy thumbnails, click-to-navigate, and **drag-and-drop
  reordering** of pages.
- **Search (Ctrl+F)**: in-document search with snippets, on-page highlight
  overlay in every view mode, and a background SQLite FTS5 index.
- **Annotations**: highlight, sticky note, and freehand ink with hit-testing,
  double-click note editing, an "All Annotations" sidebar, and JSON export.
  Bookmarks (Ctrl+D) with a sorted sidebar.
- **Page management**: rotate, delete, move, and reorder pages with reload.
- **OCR**: in-process PaddleOCR engine (`Sdcb.PaddleOCR`) producing per-line text
  runs with bounding boxes; cached to disk and invalidated by engine version.
- **Export**: PDF → DOCX export (OpenXML).
- **Theming**: Light / Dark / High-Contrast palettes shared by the PDF and DjVu
  renderers.
- **Localization**: Russian (default-capable) and English UI strings with
  hot-switching, applied before the first frame to avoid an English flash.
- **Licensing & trial**: DPAPI-backed license storage, ECDSA-P256 license
  verification, license import dialog (Tools → Import License), and a 30-day
  anti-tamper trial.
- **Recent files** (MRU) and a **Settings** dialog (theme, language, disk-cache
  size, clear-on-exit).
- **Installer**: multi-tier Inno Setup installer (Basic / Standard / Full),
  differing by which OCR model tiers are bundled.

## Changed

- **OCR engine switched from Tesseract to PaddleOCR** (in-process via
  `Sdcb.PaddleOCR`). Models are loaded offline; the language map translates
  Tesseract-style codes (e.g. `eng+rus`) to the corresponding latin/cyrillic
  model sets.

## Known limitations

- **Alpha quality**: not yet validated across a broad corpus of documents or
  hardware configurations.
- **OCR models are fetched separately.** They are not committed to the repo; the
  installer's Standard/Full tiers bundle them, but a from-source build requires
  running `tools/fetch-natives.ps1` to download the PaddleOCR models first.
- **The installer is unsigned** unless a code-signing certificate is configured
  in CI (`SIGNING_CERT_BASE64` / `SIGNING_CERT_PASSWORD`). Without it, Windows
  SmartScreen will warn on first run. Verify the download via `SHA256SUMS`
  (see below) regardless.
- The installer ships without a custom application icon
  (`foliant.ico` is not yet wired up).
- **Inline text editing is deferred** — Foliant is a reader; editing existing
  document text is out of scope for this release.
- DjVu support requires DjVuLibre (`ddjvu`/`djvused`) available to the DjVu
  plugin; PDF rendering uses bundled PDFium and has no external dependency.

## Install

1. Download the installer for your tier from the assets below:
   - **Basic** — viewer only, no OCR models.
   - **Standard** — bundles the common OCR model tier.
   - **Full** — bundles all OCR model tiers.
2. (Recommended) Verify the download against `SHA256SUMS` before running it.
3. Run the installer and follow the prompts. Because the alpha build may be
   unsigned, you may need to click "More info" → "Run anyway" past SmartScreen.

### Verify the download (SHA256)

`SHA256SUMS` is published alongside the installers. Compare the hash of your
download with the value listed there.

PowerShell:

```powershell
# Prints the SHA-256 of the downloaded installer in lowercase
(Get-FileHash .\Foliant-Setup-Full-v0.1.0.exe -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower()
# Compare it against the matching line in SHA256SUMS
Select-String -Path .\SHA256SUMS -Pattern 'Foliant-Setup-Full-v0.1.0.exe'
```

bash (WSL / Git Bash):

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS 2>/dev/null | grep Foliant-Setup-Full
```

The hashes must match exactly. If they do not, do not run the installer.

## System requirements

- Windows 10 21H2 (build 19044) or later, 64-bit (x64).
